metadata.title: NOAA H12617 multibeam bathymetry — San Pedro and vicinity (2013)
metadata.source: NOAA/NOS H12617 (2013-09-13 to 2013-11-03), Reson 7125 multibeam; 1 m and 2 m finalized BAG products (2019 packaging). Historical archive, not present-day port conditions.
metadata.horizontal_transform: pyproj NAD83 UTM11N -> NAD83 geographic; geographic NAD83 displayed in local ENU without realization-specific WGS84 correction.
metadata.reference_water_level_note: 0 m MLLW demonstration reference, NOT MSL or live tide. Land remains NAVD88; no spatial vertical datum transformation applied. Do not infer precise shore/seabed elevation ties.
metadata.nodata_rule: BAG 1e6, unsupported samples and missing support cells remain -9999; all four corners required; no CRM/CoNED/synthetic infill. 1 m measured product takes priority over 2 m measured product.
metadata.uncertainty_note: Range of maximum BAG productUncert over four interpolation support cells, valid rendered samples only; not project RMSE, not local measurement accuracy guarantee. See source BAG uncertainty band for per-cell data.
metadata.accuracy_note: Grid spacing is not survey accuracy. Historical MBES data; local uncertainty, dated coverage, vertical datum/epoch and field acceptance remain to be checked.
metadata.intended_use: Visualization only; NOAA explicitly excludes navigation. No artificial procedural seafloor detail. Unknown/land/outside-survey cells remain holes.
